translationRepairs: 博洛 was reassigned from the post of canzheng.
Bolo was reassigned from the post of canzheng (vice commissioner).
s0034 has 博洛自參政改; English must romanize 博洛 as Bolo, and the gloss vice commissioner correctly explains early-Qing 參政/canzheng without inventing content.
尼堪 was reassigned from the post of chengzheng.
Nikan was reassigned from the post of chengzheng (commissioner).
s0035 has 尼堪自承政改; romanizing 尼堪 as Nikan and glossing 承政/chengzheng as commissioner restores readable English faithful to the office term.
s0106 is the fused string 趙繼鼎佟國應; these are two separate personal names and must be split and romanized as Zhao Jiding and Tong Guoying.
The literal likewise leaves 趙繼鼎佟國應 fused; separating and romanizing the two names matches the Chinese cell content.
In the intercalary second month, 徐啓元 retired from office. On the wuchen day, 洪承疇管: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the yimao day of the eighth month, 趙開心: Left Censor-in-Chief.

In the intercalary second month, Xu Qiyuan retired from office. On the wuchen day, Hong Chengchou administered the post of Left Censor-in-Chief. On the yimao day of the eighth month, Zhao Kaixin: Left Censor-in-Chief.
In 戊辰洪承疇管左都御史, 管 is the verb “administered,” not part of a name; the prior “洪承疇管: Left Censor-in-Chief” invents a false name form, and the proposed wording restores the correct sense.
房可壯 retired from office. On the gengyin day of the first month, 金之俊: Left Censor-in-Chief. In the intercalary sixth month, was transferred. On the wuzi day, 趙開心復: Left Censor-in-Chief.

Fang Kezhuang retired from office. On the gengyin day of the first month, Jin Zhijun: Left Censor-in-Chief. In the intercalary sixth month, was transferred. On the wuzi day, Zhao Kaixin again became Left Censor-in-Chief.
s0134 ends 戊子趙開心復爲左都御史; 復爲 means “again became,” so treating 趙開心復 as a name is wrong, and the proposed “again became Left Censor-in-Chief” matches the Chinese.
納都戶能圖: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
s0157’s 納都戶能圖左副都御史 juxtaposes two personal names before the office; fusing them as one referent is incorrect, and separating Naduhu and Nengtu restores the roster reading.
納都戶能圖: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
The literal’s fused 納都戶能圖 likewise misreads two officeholders as one; separating Naduhu and Nengtu matches the Chinese.

On the yiwei day of the third month, 周亮工 was transferred. On the gengzi day, 曹溶: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the renchen day of the seventh month, was transferred. On the jihai day, 孫建宗: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the ninth month, 外用. On the jiayin day of the tenth month, 魏裔介: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

On the yiwei day of the third month, Zhou Lianggong was transferred. On the gengzi day, Cao Rong: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the renchen day of the seventh month, was transferred. On the jihai day, Sun Jianzong: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the ninth month, he was appointed to an outer post. On the jiayin day of the tenth month, Wei Yijie: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
九月外用 is an outer/provincial appointment formula, not a personal name, so the prior “外用.” is wrong; drop the proposal’s bracket hedging and render it as “he was appointed to an outer post.”
s0170 is the fused string 魏裔介克星格; these are two officials’ names and must be split as Wei Yijie and Kexingge.
The literal likewise fuses 魏裔介克星格; separating the two romanized names restores the correct reading of the cell.
On the gengshen day of the third month, 霍達 went on leave. Soon died. On the jiwei day of the fourth month, 魏裔介復: Left Censor-in-Chief.
On the gengshen day of the third month, Huoda went on leave. Soon died. On the jiwei day of the fourth month, Wei Yijie again became Left Censor-in-Chief.
s0220 has 魏裔介復爲左都御史; 復爲 means “again became,” so “魏裔介復: Left Censor-in-Chief” wrongly absorbs 復 into the name, and the proposed wording corrects it.
